description: Abstract class implementing script invocation and evaluation logic with timeout handling, statistics, and error management for the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: AbstractScriptInvokeService
classes.description: Abstract class providing core logic for script invocation, evaluation, timeout handling, and statistics within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes statistics counters and callback handlers, and sets up the timeout executor if needed.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the timeout executor service.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates script body size and execution permissions.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a script asynchronously with timeout and statistics tracking.

methods.name: invokeScript
methods.description: Invokes a script with arguments asynchronously, handling size limits, errors, and timeouts.

methods.name: withTimeoutAndStatsCallback
methods.description: Wraps a future with timeout and callback for statistics.

methods.name: handleScriptException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during script execution, manages script disablement on errors.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases resources and enables re-invocation of scripts.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Checks if a script is currently disabled due to errors.

methods.name: scriptBodySizeExceeded
methods.description: Checks if script body exceeds maximum size.

methods.name: argsSizeExceeded
methods.description: Checks if total argument size exceeds maximum allowed.

methods.name: resultSizeExceeded
methods.description: Checks if script result exceeds maximum size.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Creates a failed future with an error message.

methods.name: getStatsType
methods.description: Abstract method to get the statistics type for this service.
